'''Fyall''' is a village in [[Ghealdan]].

==Activities==

When [[Rand al'Thor]] was making his way from [[Falme]] to [[Tear]], he passed through the village of Fyall. After he left, the Mayor dug up a bag of coins that were minted in [[Manetheren]], which had a woman's face on one side and an eagle on the other. [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Loial]] pass through the village a few days later.{{ref/book|3|33}}
